ShaderNodePreset.Description: Object mattes from a cwSegment Object IDs map. RGB + Matte: pick an object for each of R, G, B and the Matte output. One Object: that object in all channels. Range: objects From..To as one matte. Feed the ID map unfiltered.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: cwExtract

Uniform.Tooltip: cwSegment with Output = Object IDs (object k = k x 0.02). Must be unfiltered: no resize, blur or colour transform in between.
Uniform.Name: idTex

Uniform.Tooltip: RGB + Matte: one object per channel (R, G, B, Matte output). One Object: one object in all channels. Range: objects From..To merged into one matte in all channels.
Uniform.Name: mode

Uniform.Tooltip: Output 1 - matte (background matte) in every channel.
Uniform.Name: invertOut

Uniform.Tooltip: RGB + Matte: object number in Red (0 = none). Numbers as in cwSegment's ID Map view.
Uniform.Name: objR

Uniform.Tooltip: RGB + Matte: object number in Green (0 = none).
Uniform.Name: objG

Uniform.Tooltip: RGB + Matte: object number in Blue (0 = none).
Uniform.Name: objB

Uniform.Tooltip: RGB + Matte: object number on the Matte output (0 = none).
Uniform.Name: objMatte

Uniform.Tooltip: One Object: the object number, output in all channels.
Uniform.Name: objOne
